resources.string: Video and music: panel and gestures
Swipe up or down with a finger or mouse on the volume side of the screen: the volume changes and its value shows on screen.
Swipe up or down with a finger or mouse on the brightness side of the screen: the brightness changes and its value shows on screen.
Which half of the screen controls brightness and which controls volume.
Drag left or right and keep your finger down: the new time is shown, and the jump is made when you let go.
Next or previous file by fling
A quick fling to the left opens the next file of the list, to the right the previous one.
How many seconds of video fit into the full screen width when you drag.
Return the panel, gestures and music in background to the default values.
On: the mode chosen with the “Fit to screen” button is remembered and used for the next videos and launches. Off: every video opens as “fit”, and the button works only while that video plays.
Could not read the file to install
What the small second line of a file or folder shows: date and time (modified or created) with the size, or the number of folders and files. “None” hides the second line.
